title: Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper

Benfleet £33,000 - £38,000 DOE Full-Time

Looking for a Bookkeeping Role Where Your Experience Truly Matters?

We're seeking an experienced Bookkeeper to join a friendly accountancy practice in Benfleet. If you enjoy taking ownership of your work, thrive in a varied role, and want to be part of a supportive team that values your expertise, we'd love to hear from you.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with current accountancy practice experience who is looking for a stable, long-term position with plenty of variety and the chance to develop their skills further.

What You'll Be Doing

As a key member of the team, you'll be responsible for managing a broad range of bookkeeping and finance duties, including:
- Managing Purchase, Sales and Nominal Ledgers
- Processing payroll accurately and efficiently
- Completing bank and nominal ledger reconciliations
- Supporting clients with day-to-day bookkeeping requirements
- Assisting with general office administration when required
- Supporting Tax Computations and P11 Ds (experience in these areas would be beneficial)

What We're Looking For

To succeed in this role, you'll have:

Previous experience working within an accountancy practice (essential)

A strong understanding of double-entry bookkeeping

The ability to complete reconciliations independently and accurately

Confidence using accounting software and Excel

Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail

A proactive, reliable and team-oriented approach

Bonus points if you have experience preparing Tax Computations and P11 Ds.

Why Join Us?
- Competitive salary of £33,000 - £38,000, depending on experience
- Join a supportive and professional team environment
- Enjoy a varied role with responsibility and autonomy
- Opportunity to broaden your technical knowledge and experience
- Stable, long-term career opportunity within a well-established practice
- Immediate start available for the right candidate

Apply Today

If you're an experienced Bookkeeper looking for your next challenge in a welcoming and professional accountancy practice, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now for immediate consideration and take the next step in your bookkeeping career.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller

Chelmsford

Full Time- Office Based

General Responsibility

Working within the Operations Department, providing support to the Client Management teams for proactive management of a portfolio of clients.

To deliver exceptional Client service, maintain internal and Client relationships, and effectively identify any risks to prevent loss of income and reputation to our business.

Responsibilities-

Credit Control:
- To deliver and maintain proactive and effective

collections processes, whilst delivering excellent service to the Clients.
- To ensure collection and follow-up calls are made within

agreed timescales.
- To ensure adequate levels of verification are maintained

on the Client's Ledgers at all times.
- To record and maintain up-to-date debtor contact

details
- To record and maintain the debtor diary and collection

notes on the operating system.
- To assist the data processing team by obtaining

remittance advice and allocation details for expected

debtor receipts.
- To identify any sales ledger queries and work closely

with the Client Management teams to ensure that

Clients resolve disputes quickly and are aware of any

difficult recovery situations that may require legal

action.
- Maintaining first-class Client relationships, ensuring that

excellent levels of service are delivered so that the Client

Satisfaction levels remain high.
- To make recommendations on how the Credit Control

function can be improved/enhanced.

Risk Management:
- To ensure the security of funds at all times,

minimising client losses and bad debts.
- To work closely with the Client Management teams in

reviewing and scrutinising debt collectability and

recoverability daily.
- To provide regular feedback to the Client Management

teams about any debt issues that may impact upon

security or client retention.

Maximise Income:

To identify and introduce new business opportunities

where appropriate.

Internal Customers:

To work closely with all other Departments to ensure

that the Operations department runs in an efficient and

professional way at all times. Any issues or concerns

should be escalated to senior management

immediately.

To provide staff training where appropriate.

title: Credit Controller
description:

title: HR & Payroll Assistant
description:
HR & Payroll Assistant

Salary: £28,000 - £32,000

Full-time Permanent

Are you looking to develop your career across HR and Payroll? We are looking for an organised and detail-focused HR & Payroll Assistant to provide essential administrative support across a busy HR function.

This is a varied role offering exposure to HR administration, payroll, learning and development, and the wider employee lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

HR Administration
- Provide day-to-day administrative support to the HR team.
- Maintain accurate and confidential employee records in line with GDPR.
- Prepare HR documentation including contracts, letters and employee correspondence.
- Support onboarding and leaver processes.
- Update employee records for changes to contracts, hours, roles and personal details.
- Maintain absence and family leave records.
- Ensure HR files and records remain accurate and audit-ready.

Payroll Support
- Process payroll administration for new starters and leavers.
- Collate and check working hours, overtime and other payroll information.
- Ensure salary, contract and leave changes are accurately communicated to payroll.
- Assist with resolving payroll queries and discrepancies.
- Maintain accurate records to support monthly payroll processing.

Learning & Development
- Maintain employee training records and learning databases.
- Record training courses and employee completions.
- Support the coordination of training activities.
- Assist with training reports and monitoring mandatory training.

General HR Support
- Respond to HR queries professionally and promptly.
- Assist with HR reports, spreadsheets and management information.
- Support HR projects and initiatives.
- Handle sensitive information with confidentiality and professionalism.

About You

We are looking for someone with:
- Previous experience in HR, Payroll or a relevant administrative role.
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail.
- Experience handling confidential and sensitive information.
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- A proactive, positive and professional approach.
- The ability to work effectively as part of a team and independently.

Desirable:
- Experience using HR or Payroll systems.
- Understanding of payroll processes and employment legislation.
- Knowledge of HR administration, including contracts, family leave and employee records.
- CIPD qualification or working towards one.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a career within HR and Payroll, gaining broad experience across a busy and varied HR function.

If you are organised, proactive and keen to develop your HR and Payroll career, apply today!

title: HR and Payroll Administrator
company: Sterling Recruitment Solutions Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Title: HR & Payroll Administrator

Location: Dunmow, Essex

Salary: Up to £27,000 per annum (Depending on Experience)
